subject: Mutual action plan & sequencing for MSA/DPA/Order Form - ClearPath
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearpathmed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan & sequencing for MSA/DPA/Order Form - ClearPath

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, putting a short mutual action plan (MAP) on paper will help both teams coordinate procurement and legal sequencing for the MSA/DPA/order form. I attached a very rough outline (MAP-outline-v0.1.xlsx) with the milestones I'm thinking:

- Exec intro & procurement contacts (this week)
- Legal redlines & SOC2 evidence request (1–2 weeks)
- Order form negotiation and signature (contingent on SOC2 evidence)
- Onboarding kickoff & provisioning

Can you confirm: 1) preferred procurement contacts; 2) any internal sign-off gates (security, privacy, vendor risk); 3) a realistic target date for order form sign-off?

If it helps we'll produce a one-page MAP PDF and a DocuSign-ready order form so your legal/procurement can review in parallel.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference — Inference you can trust
Attachment: MAP-outline-v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearpathmed.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearpathmed.com
Date: 2026-08-16T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & sequencing for MSA/DPA/Order Form - ClearPath

Connor —

Appreciate the outline. Quick answers:

1) Procurement lead: procurement@clearpathmed.com (cc'd).
2) Sign-off gates: Security review (security team), Privacy review, and Budget approval from Finance. Security will need SOC2 Type II evidence and a short data-flow diagram.
3) Target: procurement/legal want to aim for an order form signed by Aug 31, but that assumes we get SOC2 evidence + your standard DPA within the next week.

I attached the current SOW we think should map to the order form (CPL_ClearPath_SOW.pdf). I can ask security to prioritize the evidence if you can confirm what specific docs we should provide.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Strategic Sourcing | ClearPath Medical
elena.morales@clearpathmed.com | +1 612-555-0148
Attachment: CPL_ClearPath_SOW.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & sequencing for MSA/DPA/Order Form - ClearPath

Connor / Rishi —

Thanks for the signal, Elena. Fwd'ing a suggested internal sequencing and delivery commitments. High level:

- Today (Aug 17): We draft a single-page MAP (action owners + dates) and a redline-friendly order form.
- Aug 18–19: Legal (Rishi) will prepare MSA + standard DPA language; we'll produce a MAP-v0.2.pdf combining those milestones.
- Aug 20–24: Parallel reviews: your security checks SOC2 artifacts; procurement reviews order form pricing/term page.
- Aug 25–31: Finalize legal redlines and obtain signatures; target sign-off Aug 31 (Elena's target).

Rishi — can you confirm there are any MSA clauses we should pre-flag for ClearPath (data residency, subprocessing, audit rights)? I'll draft the MAP-draft-v0.1.docx and share for quick review.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0104

Date: 2026-08-19T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Updated MAP and next steps (attached)

Elena / team —

Attached is MAP-v0.2.pdf — a one-page mutual action plan with named owners and target dates aligned to your requested Aug 31 sign-off. Key commitments from Redwood:

- Delivery of standard DPA + MSA template (Rishi) by Aug 19
- SOC2 artifact package (security controls summary, auditor contact) provided by Aug 24
- Order form (pricing + terms) in DocuSign by Aug 25 for parallel procurement review

We also included a suggested fallback: if SOC2 evidence is delayed past Aug 24, Redwood will accept an audit contingency clause with a 30-day evidence delivery window so procurement can proceed to sign the order form with that contingency.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/close/CP-2026-089-orderform

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP-v0.2.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Updated MAP and next steps (attached)

Connor / Marissa / Rishi —

Thanks for pulling this together. Security reviewed the ask and said: provide SOC2 Type II report (or SOC2 letter of attestation) + controls summary and a short data-flow diagram. We can prioritize review; procurement is comfortable moving forward with the contingency clause you suggested so long as the order form includes the audit-contingency language and a firm deadline for evidence (Aug 24).

I've attached a short PDF with our redlines to the MAP and the suggested contingency wording (redlines_8-21.pdf). Two small asks before procurement signs:

1) Add explicit statement of data residency in the order form (US-only)
2) Confirm subprocessor list availability within 5 business days of signature

If those two items are acceptable we'll route the DocuSign order form on Aug 25 and aim to sign by Aug 31. Please confirm and I'll have procurement kick off the DocuSign flow.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Strategic Sourcing | ClearPath Medical
Attachment: redlines_8-21.pdf (pdf)
